rendering.text: Tuck PDFKit extraction / Apple Vision OCR; raw original language; identical text in both text-bearing modes

rules.Migration/AGENCY: Documents explicitly part of a AGENCY migration application bundle, including financial or employment attachments. This explicit grouping takes priority over document topic.
rules.Migration: Residence permits, immigration applications and migration decisions that are not explicitly in a AGENCY bundle.
rules.Work: Employment certificates, employment contracts and payslips.
rules.Insurance: Insurance policies and insurance certificates, including home and travel insurance.
rules.Home: Residential tenancy or rental agreements and household utility bills. Hotel bookings are Travel.
rules.Finances: Bank statements, invoices, receipts, payments, and purchase or membership order confirmations.
rules.Travel: Hotel bookings, travel reservations and tickets.
rules.Identity: Passports, identity cards, driving licences and birth certificates.
rules.Health: Medical records, medical certificates and prescriptions.
rules.Needs Review: The supplied evidence does not establish one matching topic, or remains contradictory.

notes: Direct one-pass input experiment; not the full production coordinator, checker or naming pipeline.
No model-controlled tools, no moves, no production changes.
Every image-mode request must receive its images; no text fallback.
Synthetic fixtures and input labels frozen before scored inference.
Original-language text, no translation. One run per condition; exploratory, not a general accuracy estimate.
